sensitivePaths.label: Send a campaign
sensitivePaths.warning: to its whole audience, at once

agentGuide: Base path /3.0. Audiences (lists): GET /lists (lists[].id, name, stats.member_count). Members: GET /lists/<id>/members?count=20&status=subscribed; one: GET /lists/<id>/members/<md5 of the lowercase email>; add or update: PUT /lists/<id>/members/<md5> {"email_address": "...", "status_if_new": "subscribed", "merge_fields": {"FNAME": "..."}}; tags: POST /lists/<id>/members/<md5>/tags {"tags": [{"name": "vip", "status": "active"}]}. Campaigns: GET /campaigns?status=sent&count=10; one: GET /campaigns/<id>; report: GET /reports/<id> (opens, clicks); create: POST /campaigns {"type": "regular", "recipients": {"list_id": "..."}, "settings": {"subject_line": "...", "from_name": "...", "reply_to": "..."}}, content: PUT /campaigns/<id>/content {"html": "..."}; send: POST /campaigns/<id>/actions/send — asks for confirmation. Search: GET /search-members?query=<email>. The credentials are set by Allkin.
